title: A release with no measurement at the current preview probe shows only 'Not measured with preview probe v9', prompts the measure commands, and stays locked
steps: S1: Check a release whose VERIFICATION.json carries a measurement of another version (no file of its own version) and summarize it.
S2: Check JA Directory Joomla 1.0.3 (its committed measurement file at preview probe v9) on five rules and summarize it.
S3: Build the road of a release not live whose stored check carries a previewProbe gap, ask the publish door, and ask the same road for a live line.
S4: Ask the /ops guide for step design-system code ds-not-at-probe.
expect: S1: grade null, 0/0, no must-fix, worth-fixing or not-measured groups; notAtProbe { current 9, measured null } whose measure text runs stand up, flow --measure-version, preview-check --write, stand down.
S2: no previewProbe on any result; a grade, total 5, measuredOn 1.0.3 and findings stamped 'preview probe v9'.
S3: step todo ds-not-at-probe, never ds-ready; Publish blocked by design-system with DESIGN_SYSTEM_NOT_READY '1.0.2 is not measured with preview probe v9'; a live line warns with the same code.
S4: title 'Design system · Not measured with preview probe v9', no rule groups, and the prompt's second line is the measure command.
evidence: dev /ops 16/10/2026: JA Donate Joomla 1.0.6 (no measurement file) read 'Design system · C · 8/44 passed · 29 must fix · 8 not measured yet', prompt opening with VARS-1; reproduced with check-runner.mjs on the release files
fence: readiness summary, road step and /ops guide; no stand, no Postgres
